name: Vienna
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a vivid ginger-copper base with slightly deeper auburn tones at the root. Fine ribbons of lighter copper catch the light throughout, while soft peach-blonde highlights frame the face. Richer red-copper tones underneath give the color depth and keep the brighter pieces distinct.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final.
